**Finding: compliant (preferred level) — no redline proposed.**

Section 24 delivers the full preferred ASSIGN bargain in our favour:

- **24.1** — we may assign to an Affiliate *or* to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition or sale of all/substantially all assets without Vendor consent (prompt written notice only).
- **24.2** — Vendor may not assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent, not to be unreasonably withheld; and may never assign to a direct Customer competitor.
- **24.3** — the residual consent standard is mutual and not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed.
- **24.4** — our change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service; Vendor must cooperate with successor administrative changes.

I also confirmed there is no competing change-of-control or re-pricing trigger elsewhere (§ 9 Termination, § 13.3 licence transfer, § 30 General), and the "Affiliate" definition (§ 1.1, >50% control) is standard. The only sub-preferred details — "direct" competitor and the competitor bar being subject to our own (waivable) consent, plus the notice requirement in 24.1 — are immaterial and are noted rather than flagged.
